facts.text: All Butler University students entering in fall 2010 or later must complete at least one Indianapolis Community Requirement course involving active engagement with the Indianapolis community.

sources.title: Indianapolis Community Requirement | Butler University
sources.quote: Students must take one course in any part of the University that involves active engagement with the Indianapolis community.

sources.title: Indianapolis Community Requirement | Butler University
sources.quote: All Butler students entering in fall 2010 or later must complete at least one ICR course before graduation.
